scripts.prod:rebuild: docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml build --no-cache && docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml up -d --force-recreate
scripts.prod:deploy: git pull --ff-only && npm run prod:up && npm run prod:migrate && npm run prod:optimize
scripts.prod:about: docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml exec app php artisan about
scripts.prod:shell: docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml exec app bash
scripts.prod:artisan: docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml exec app php artisan
scripts.prod:tinker: docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml exec app php artisan tinker
scripts.prod:key:generate: grep -qE '^APP_KEY=base64:.+' .env 2>/dev/null && { echo 'APP_KEY is already set in .env - use: npm run prod:key:rotate'; exit 1; }; KEY=$(docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml run --rm -T --no-deps --entrypoint php app artisan key:generate --show --no-ansi | tr -dc 'A-Za-z0-9+/=:'); case "$KEY" in base64:*) ;; *) echo 'Key generation failed'; exit 1;; esac; touch .env; if grep -q '^APP_KEY=' .env; then sed -i "s|^APP_KEY=.*|APP_KEY=$KEY|" .env; else echo "APP_KEY=$KEY" >> .env; fi; echo 'APP_KEY written to .env - now run: npm run prod:recreate'
scripts.prod:key:rotate: KEY=$(docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml run --rm -T --no-deps --entrypoint php app artisan key:generate --show --no-ansi | tr -dc 'A-Za-z0-9+/=:'); case "$KEY" in base64:*) ;; *) echo 'Key generation failed'; exit 1;; esac; cp .env .env.bak.$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S); OLD=$(grep '^APP_KEY=' .env | cut -d= -f2-); sed -i "s|^APP_KEY=.*|APP_KEY=$KEY|" .env; grep -q '^APP_PREVIOUS_KEYS=' .env && sed -i "s|^APP_PREVIOUS_KEYS=.*|APP_PREVIOUS_KEYS=$OLD|" .env || echo "APP_PREVIOUS_KEYS=$OLD" >> .env; echo 'APP_KEY rotated (old key kept in APP_PREVIOUS_KEYS, .env backed up) - now run: npm run prod:recreate'
scripts.prod:migrate: docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml exec app php artisan migrate --force --ansi
scripts.prod:migrate:status: docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml exec app php artisan migrate:status
scripts.prod:migrate:rollback: docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml exec app php artisan migrate:rollback --force --ansi
scripts.prod:seed: docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml exec app php artisan db:seed --force --ansi
scripts.prod:db:shell: docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml exec db sh -c 'psql -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -d "$POSTGRES_DB"'
scripts.prod:db:backup: mkdir -p backups && docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml exec -T db sh -c 'pg_dump -U "$POSTGRES_USER" "$POSTGRES_DB"' > backups/db-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S).sql && ls -lh backups | tail -1
scripts.prod:optimize: docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml exec app php artisan optimize --ansi
scripts.prod:optimize:clear: docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml exec app php artisan optimize:clear --ansi
scripts.prod:cache:clear: docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml exec app php artisan cache:clear --ansi
scripts.prod:storage:link: docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml exec app php artisan storage:link --ansi
scripts.prod:perms: docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml exec app sh -c 'chown -R www-data:www-data storage bootstrap/cache && chmod -R 775 storage bootstrap/cache'
scripts.prod:orchid:admin: docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml exec app php artisan orchid:admin
scripts.prod:down:maintenance: docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml exec app php artisan down --render=errors::503
scripts.prod:up:maintenance: docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml exec app php artisan up
scripts.prod:caddy:validate: docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml exec caddy caddy validate --config /etc/caddy/Caddyfile
scripts.prod:caddy:reload: docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml exec caddy caddy reload --config /etc/caddy/Caddyfile
